world.title: 曼德勃罗集边界的无限细节
world.posterTitle: 迭代公式生成自相似的分形边界
world.posterHook: 一个公式画出的宇宙：黑色是永远逃不出的点，彩色是逃逸快慢。放大边界，海马谷与螺旋层层展开——相似，却永不重复。
world.posterSource: WebGL · 逃逸时间着色 · 本地 GPU 实时渲染
world.question: 为什么一个公式的边界，越放大越看不完？
world.hook: 每个像素是一个数字。反复做 z²+c：永远不飞走的点涂成黑色，飞走的用颜色标出逃逸快慢。边界上放大再放大，永远有新图案。
world.payoff: 这就是曼德博集合：数学上无限复杂，却只靠一条规则生成。GPU 大约能放大到 10¹⁴ 倍；再往下，我们会跳到另一片著名边界继续看。

en.title: Infinite detail along the Mandelbrot set boundary
en.posterTitle: An iterative formula produces a self-similar fractal boundary
en.posterHook: One formula paints a universe: black means trapped forever, color means how fast you escape. Zoom the boundary—seahorse valleys and spirals unfold, similar yet never the same.
en.posterSource: WebGL · Escape-time coloring · Local GPU real-time rendering
en.question: Why does one formula’s boundary never run out as you zoom?
en.hook: Each pixel is a number. Iterate z²+c: points that never fly away are painted black; escapees are colored by speed. Zoom the edge again and again—new patterns always appear.
en.payoff: That is the Mandelbrot set: infinitely complex, born from one rule. The GPU reaches about 10¹⁴×; beyond that we hop to another famous valley and keep diving.
